label: Through depth: one mode followed from stem to logits
note:
Through depth at step {{fact:final_step}} (cosine kernel, {{fact:mode_name.rule0}}): mode 1 of the depth-coupled operator in relative site units at $t = t^*$; each site's panel shows its own slice $u_l = f_l/|f_l|$, scaled to $\pm 1$. Other rows are not coloured.
The side card gives the mode's share at each site against what the sites' gaps alone would give (dashed). Mode numbers are local to a setting.
Try: drag the coupling slider down to $t^*/64$ and watch slices turn grey (under 1% of the mode), then switch to the paper's matrix, then click the step-64 row.

label: Through depth: five sets with centroids shared across sites
note:
Through depth at step {{fact:final_step}}: a post-hoc readout (k-means is a fit), $k = 5$, shape-aligned: one k-means with centroids shared across the {{fact:n_sites}} sites on the first 8 modes' slices, each site rotated onto the previous one. The same colour is the same centroid at every site; grey = no label.
Try: click a set in the legend to isolate it, switch the readout to shared coordinates, then pick another site in the first card.
